_comment: Mannequin body-geometry profiles keyed by sha256 of the source GLB bytes (spec FR 14, amendment 10). Rendered A_TPose with --arm-drop 45 at res 704 with the drive camera (ortho 3.0, elevation 45, head lift 25, default rig), once per isometric direction s, se, e, ne, n; body_h and floor_y are pixel values at that resolution, measured from tests/fixtures/mannequin_apose_<female|male>_<dir>_704.png. The body keeps its pixel size at larger canvases (drive rule), with the floor line shifted by (canvas-704)//2.
